answer: Hardware-rooted attestation protects an AI-agent economy from Sybil attacks by binding agent state to secure enclaves. An attacker seeking to harbor fake nodes across an ocean of virtual hosts incurs the verifiable cost of provisioning physical, certified silicon per identity. Each enclave signs outputs with a cryptographic pigment confirming valid hardware state. However, this architecture relies on centralized chipmakers for root certificates and remains vulnerable to side-channel exploits.
